Format OTU and taxonomy tables for vegan

Source: R/vtamR_helper_functions.R
format_for_vegan.Rd

Converts OTU/ASV abundance and taxonomy input tables into the format required for downstream analysis with the vegan package. The OTU table is returned with samples as rows and ASVs (or clusters) as columns, while the taxonomy table contains taxonomy information for the ASVs present in the OTU table.

Usage

format_for_vegan(
  otu,
  tax,
  rm_coltrol = TRUE,
  sample_type = NULL,
  outfile_motu = NULL,
  outfile_taxa = NULL,
  sep = ",",
  log_file = NULL
)

Arguments

otu

Character string giving the path to the OTU/ASV abundance table, or a data frame. The table must contain asv_id, sample, and read_count columns. An optional replicate or cluster_id column may also be present.

tax

Character string giving the path to the taxonomy table, or a data frame. The table must contain an asv_id column and taxonomy columns corresponding to the expected ranks.

rm_coltrol

Logical; if TRUE, remove control samples and retain only samples whose sample_type is "real". Defaults to TRUE.

sample_type

Character string giving the path to the sample_type table, or a data frame. Required when rm_coltrol = TRUE. The table must contain sample and sample_type columns.

outfile_motu

Optional character string specifying the output file path for the formatted OTU table. If NULL, the table is not written to disk.

outfile_taxa

Optional character string specifying the output file path for the formatted taxonomy table. If NULL, the table is not written to disk.

sep

Character used to separate fields in input and output files. Defaults to ",".

log_file

Character string specifying the path to the CSV log file. The path is resolved with the following priority:

  1. the log_file argument, if explicitly provided by the user;

  2. the vtamR.log_file option set with options(vtamR.log_file = ...), if set;

  3. "vtamR_log.csv" in the current working directory, used as a last resort if neither of the above is set.

To disable logging entirely, set log_file = NA.

Value

A list of two data frames:

  • otu_table: A sample-by-ASV (or sample-by-cluster) abundance table, with sample identifiers as row names and zeroes for missing abundances.

  • tax_table: A taxonomy table containing only ASVs present in otu_table, with ASV identifiers as row names.

Details

When rm_coltrol = TRUE, only samples classified as "real" in the sample_type input are retained, thus control samples are deleted. If a replicate column is present, sample and replicate identifiers are combined into a single sample identifier using a hyphen.

If a cluster_id column is present in the OTU table, reads are aggregated by cluster and sample. Otherwise, reads are aggregated by ASV and sample.

The taxonomy table contains the columns domain, phylum, class, order, genus, and species. If a kingdom column is present in the input taxonomy table, it is also retained.

If replicate is present in the OTU table, the resulting sample identifier is constructed as sample-replicate. The same transformation is applied to the sample-type table when controls are removed.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
result <- format_for_vegan(
  otu = "otu.csv",
  tax = "taxonomy.csv",
  sample_type = "sample_type.csv"
)

otu_table <- result[[1]]
tax_table <- result[[2]]
} # }
